import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Use the searchbox to filter projects by name 'kkroening/ffmpeg-python'
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by name")
    await searchbox.fill("kkroening/ffmpeg-python")
    await searchbox.press("Enter")
    
    # Wait for the filtered results to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait for UI update
    
    # Step 2: Click on the project link to navigate to the project details page
    # Use get_by_role with exact name match for the link
    project_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="kkroening/ffmpeg-python", exact=True)
    await project_link.click()
    
    # Wait for the project details page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Step 3: Click on the 'Issues' link to go to the issues page
    issues_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Issues")
    await issues_link.click()
    
    # Wait for the issues page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Step 4: Filter issues by labels related to questions
    # Look for a 'Labels' button or filter input
    labels_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Labels")
    await labels_button.click()
    
    # Step 5: Input 'question' to filter labels
    label_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search labels")
    await label_input.fill("question")
    await label_input.press("Enter")
    
    # Wait for the filtered results to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Step 6: Extract the list of issues
    # Use listitem role for issues and filter to ensure they contain issue links
    issues = page.get_by_role("listitem").filter(has=page.get_by_role("link", name=lambda name: "issue" in name.lower() if name else False))
    issue_count = await issues.count()
    
    # Step 7: Display the list of issues by printing each one exactly
    for i in range(issue_count):
        issue = issues.nth(i)
        title = await issue.text_content()
        print(title.strip())
    
    # Since the task is to display the list, I'll set terminate_with_result to indicate completion
    return "List of issues displayed above."
